verses.1: There was also a man in Caesarea named Cornelius. He was a centurion from the army of Italy.
verses.2: A devout and fearful person of the God, with everyone in his house also being so. He brought peace to many people, and he obeyed the God completely.
verses.3: He saw in a vision clearly that just as the angel of God descended before him at noon, so too did he come to him and said to him: “Cornalius.”
verses.4: But he, who had noticed him and became curious, said, “What is it, sir?” And he replied, “Your prayers and your kindnesses have reached the memory of God.”
verses.5: And now, I will send men to Joppa. Also, I will send Simon, who is called Peter.
verses.6: He is staying at the house of a certain Simon, who has a house by the sea.
verses.7: And when the messenger who spoke to him came back, he said two things: first, that there were two soldiers who were very devout and followed his orders.
verses.8: And after explaining everything to them, he sent them off to Ioppi.
verses.9: At the end of their journey, as they approached the city, Peter went up to the stage to give a speech at noon.
verses.10: And he became impatient and wanted to taste it. When they prepared it for him, he became extremely excited.
verses.11: And it is considered that the sky is a vessel that rises and descends, like a large platform, resting on the earth in four levels.
verses.12: In it all four legs of things were created, as well as everything that belongs to the earth and everything that belongs to the sky.
verses.13: And a voice was heard to him: “Anastasius, Peter, eat and drink.”
verses.14: But Peter said, “Never, my lord! We never ate anything that was unclean or impure.”
verses.15: And once again, a voice spoke to him from behind. The Lord has purified you from all sin.
verses.16: This happened three times. Immediately afterwards, the vessel was sent up into heaven.
verses.17: And when Peter thought about what he had seen, he realized that the men who were sent under Cornelius’ command had set up a barrier around Simon’s house.
verses.18: And when they spoke, they wondered whether Simon, the man who was called Peter, was staying there as a guest.
verses.19: But when Peter was about to leave, the spirit said to him, “Look! There are men who are seeking you.”
verses.20: But go ahead and climb up, and walk along with them, without revealing anything. I have sent them there.
verses.21: Then Peter stepped forward and said to those men, “I am the man you are looking for. What is the reason you have come to seek me?”
verses.22: But those who said this were Kornalius, a hundred-horse commander, a man who was righteous and feared God. He was respected by all the Jews. He received a holy message from God, and he was sent to his house. There, he heard the words of God.
verses.23: So, he gathered them together and separated them from each other. But at the end of the day, he came back with them. Some of his brothers from Ioppia also joined him.
verses.24: At the end of the day, he went into Caesarea. Cornelius, expecting him, invited his relatives and necessary friends to come along too.
verses.25: And when Peter came in, Cornelius bowed down to him as he fell to his knees.
verses.26: And Peter said to him, “Stand up! I am a man too.”
verses.27: And while he was talking with him, he entered. He found that many people had already left.
verses.28: He also said to them: “You may wonder why it is that a Jewish man should be inclined or willing to marry someone from another religion. But God has commanded that no one should speak anything unclean or improper to anyone else.”
verses.29: Therefore, I was sent back in opposition to my original request. I wonder what reason you had for sending me back like this.
verses.30: And Cornelius said, “From the fourth day until this hour, I spent the night praying in my house. And I saw a man standing before me, with a radiant expression on his face.”
verses.31: And he said, “Cornelius, your prayers and your kindnesses were remembered by God.”
verses.32: So, send Simon to Ioppias; he is called Peter. He will be staying at Simon’s house, far from the sea.
verses.33: Therefore, I have sent you this message from myself. You have done well in your role as a servant. Now, let us all stand before God and hear everything that has been said to you by the Lord.
verses.34: And when Peter opened the door, he said, “Truly, I believe that God is not partial.”
verses.35: But in every nation, there is always someone who fears him and works for his sake, striving to uphold justice in his name.
verses.36: The message that he sent to the children of Israel, in order to bring peace through Jesus Christ; he is the Lord of all things.
verses.37: You knew what was happening throughout all of Judea. This began in Galilee, after the baptism that John announced.
verses.38: Jesus was sent from Nazareth by God, with the Holy Spirit and His power. He went out to do good and to heal all those who were suffering under the oppression of sin. It was because God was with Him.
verses.39: And we, as witnesses, bear witness to all that he created in the land of the Jews and Jerusalem. He was also depicted with hands raised, as if being carried on wooden poles.
verses.40: Then the God made him appear on the third day, and he appeared clearly.
verses.41: Not for all the people, but only for those who have been chosen by God. For us, who have been raised together with Him after His resurrection from the dead.
verses.42: And he commanded us to proclaim to the people that this man is indeed the judge of those who live and die, chosen by God.
verses.43: In this way, all the prophets testify that by taking away sins through His name, He makes all those who believe in Him truly righteous.
verses.44: As Peter continued to speak, those words became a holy breath that reached everyone who heard his words.
verses.45: And those who were faithful from the group of those who received the mark also came to Peter. They said that the gift of the Holy Spirit is also spread among all nations.
verses.46: For they spoke to them in their own languages, and they also praised the God. Then Peter said:
verses.47: Is it true that those who have not been baptized can also be “cleansed” by water, just as we do?
verses.48: He also ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him how many days they should wait before being baptized.
